About

Incorporated in 1977, Reliance Chemotex Industries Ltd manufactures and sells
Synthetic & blended Yarn[1]

Key Points

Business Overview:[1][2]
RCIL is a leading manufacturer of synthetic
and blended yarns in a Single, Double, Multi
‑ply yarns with products catering to a wide spectrum of industries and end‑uses. The company produces 100% polyester, viscose, acrylic, and bamboo viscose yarns, along with blends such as polyester /viscose, polyester /acrylic, and polyester /viscose /acrylic. These yarns are available in both raw‑white and dyed fibre variants, offering customization for the customers across different segments. The company has branch offices in Kolkata and
Delhi
